note: Isabella County's zoning district dataset is published only as a licensed ESRI shapefile for purchase ($100 per township, $1,500 county, license agreement required). The county's zoning maps are per-township PDFs, and the interactive map (FetchGIS) exposes no public service endpoint. City of Mt. Pleasant, the largest city, publishes its zoning map as a PDF/at City Hall with no REST service found. No queryable zoning polygon service was found after searching ArcGIS Online/Hub and the county and city sites.
